proposals.evidence: DEDR 3754 gives Tamil/Malayalam nilā/nilavu, Telugu/Kolami nela, Parji neliñ, Gadaba neliŋ and Gondi/Konda lēnj/lēnz ‘moon/month’. These forms belong to the nil-/nel-/lenj family rather than tiṅkaḷ or Indo-Aryan candra. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

The selected simple name nouns fit these branches; Indo-Aryan nām forms and potentially contact-mediated Kannada pēru are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
